highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m147/m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: This release rolls up the entire 4.147.0 preview cycle and lands the v4 breaking changes from the Skia m132→m148 engine jump: variable font support, color font palettes, animated WebP encoding, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. Vulkan, font-resolution and stream-offset behavior changed — read the breaking changes before upgrading.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, loses value-equality
breaking.body: The Vulkan YCbCr conversion info struct now follows the SkiaSharp `GR` casing convention (`GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` instead of `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`), and it no longer implements `IEquatable`/`Equals`/`==`/`!=`. Update field/property references to the new type name and replace equality comparisons with manual field checks.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose loses its public setter
breaking.body: The property is now get-only. Code that assigned it directly must find another way to control dispose behavior (e.g. a constructor option or subclass override).

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default
breaking.body: `new SKFont().Typeface` is `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs) rather than resolving to the platform default at draw time, so `MeasureText` now returns 0 for an unconfigured font. Construct with an explicit typeface (`new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`) and detect "unset" via `Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font so text drawing keeps working, but `paint.Typeface == null` no longer detects "no typeface set" — use `Typeface.IsEmpty` or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName never returns null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms are now consistent: an unmatched family name returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of `null` on Android. For a strict "was it found" check, use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns `null` on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null
breaking.body: Default resolution moved to the font manager; behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux, and Android API 36+ (previously able to crash) now falls back to `SKTypeface.Empty` instead.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on overflow
breaking.body: The native offset is a 32-bit int; the overload previously truncated large values silently. It now does a checked cast (throwing `OverflowException` out of range) and is marked `[Obsolete]` (CS0618). Call `Move(int)` with an in-range value instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls `SK_ABORT` (terminating the process, uncatchable) instead of failing gracefully when a 1.0 instance/device is supplied. Declare `VK_API_VERSION_1_1` on both the `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion` used to create the instance and on `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` (do not leave either at 0/default). Genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must pick another backend up front.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative drops five interop fields
breaking.body: `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice` are removed. Delete those assignments; use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`. There is no replacement for `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice` — Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed (new Components field)
breaking.body: A new `Components` field (backed by a new `GRVkYcbcrComponents` struct) changes the struct's layout. Code that manually constructs or marshals this struct must account for the new field.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through milestone m147 to m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances from m132 all the way to m148 across this cycle, bringing every upstream fix and feature landed in between, plus multiple rounds of m147 bug-fix merges.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts, color font palettes and legacy font manager restored
bullets.detail: Variable font support is wired through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, SKFont/SKTypeface gain color font palette selection, and the legacy `sk_fontmgr_legacy_create_typeface` entry point returns for downstream compatibility.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution moved to the managed layer
bullets.detail: Fixes an Android API 36+ crash (#3693) and lets consumers observe/override default-typeface fallback without a native round-trip.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream conversion
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can now emit animated WebP from a frame sequence, and SKStream.GetData() converts a seekable stream to SKData without an intermediate byte[] copy.
New overloads on SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface accept SKSamplingOptions instead of an implicit default filter/mipmap mode.

bullets.lead: HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzzSharp wrappers
bullets.detail: Adds a proper HBColor struct matching hb_color_t and fills in wrappers that were missing or mis-named.

bullets.lead: Legacy paint text/font APIs promoted from obsolete to compile error
bullets.detail: The pre-v4 text/font-reading members on SKPaint that were obsoleted in v3 are now hard errors, and the remaining legacy paint state-reading APIs are obsoleted — move to SKFont for text/typeface access.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel-span stride and offset corrected
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) offset overload used Height instead of Width when computing the element offset — both are fixed.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder collected first
bullets.detail: A GC-ordering bug that could crash on finalization when an SKPathBuilder was collected before the SKPath it produced is fixed.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: Fixes a load failure of the WinUI Projection assembly when referenced from a .NET 9 application.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView blank after MAUI TabBar switch
bullets.detail: The GL surface is now correctly re-attached after the view is re-added to the tree, fixing a blank canvas after switching MAUI TabBar tabs.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's native singleton instances are initialized and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64/arm64 and Linux Bionic native targets
bullets.detail: Tizen ships x64 and arm64 native builds alongside x86/arm, and Android-hosted Linux (linux-bionic) becomes a first-class native target instead of falling back to the desktop-glibc build.

bullets.lead: Apple TFM alignment and WASM floor raised
bullets.detail: Libraries target versioned Apple TFMs (26.0) while apps use unversioned ones, matching current .NET SDK guidance; pre-.NET 8 Emscripten WASM native builds are dropped.
libexpat 2.7.5/2.8.1, libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype 2.14.3 and libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 all pick up their latest upstream security and bug fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 fixed the pixel-span stride/offset bugs, promoted legacy paint APIs to errors, merged Chrome m147 bug fixes, and reworked the singleton lifecycle ahead of stable.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor and missing HarfBuzzSharp wrappers, enabled TreatWarningsAsErrors across the binding, added SKStream.GetData(), and fixed CI/build chain issues.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, aligned Apple platform TFMs, and updated freetype/zlib.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line: variable font support, color font palettes, SKSamplingOptions on surface draws, Tizen x64/arm64 and Linux Bionic targets, and the Skia bump through milestone 147.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp adds variable-font shaping support and a proper HBColor struct, and the bundled HarfBuzz binding is refreshed to 14.2.0 alongside the v4 engine bump.
